tests.name: cbor_empty_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of an empty CBOR array which has length zero.

tests.name: cbor_single_scalar_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a CBOR array with exactly one scalar element.

tests.name: cbor_single_container_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a CBOR array containing a single nested array.

tests.name: cbor_two_element_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a CBOR array with exactly two elements entering the scalar run.

tests.name: cbor_large_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a larger CBOR array with multiple elements.

tests.name: msgpack_empty_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of an empty MessagePack array.

tests.name: msgpack_single_scalar_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a MessagePack array with a single scalar element.

tests.name: msgpack_single_container_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a MessagePack array with a single nested array element.

tests.name: msgpack_two_element_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a MessagePack array with exactly two elements.

tests.name: msgpack_large_array
tests.intent: Verify parsing of a larger MessagePack array with multiple elements.

tests.name: cbor_nested_single_arrays
tests.intent: Verify deeply nested single-element CBOR arrays work correctly under the new threshold.

tests.name: msgpack_nested_single_arrays
tests.intent: Verify deeply nested single-element MessagePack arrays work correctly under the new threshold.

tests.name: cbor_mixed_array_types
tests.intent: Verify parsing of CBOR arrays containing mixed types including objects and strings.

tests.name: msgpack_mixed_array_types
tests.intent: Verify parsing of MessagePack arrays containing mixed types including maps and strings.

tests.name: cbor_array_with_booleans
tests.intent: Verify parsing of CBOR arrays with boolean scalars that would be affected by scalar runs.

tests.name: msgpack_array_with_booleans
tests.intent: Verify parsing of MessagePack arrays with boolean scalars.

tests.name: cbor_float_array
tests.intent: Verify CBOR scalar run handling arrays containing floating point numbers.

tests.name: msgpack_float_array
tests.intent: Verify MessagePack scalar run handling arrays containing floating point numbers.

tests.name: cbor_roundtrip_equality
tests.intent: Verify round-trip serialization and deserialization for CBOR arrays around boundary lengths.

tests.name: msgpack_roundtrip_equality
tests.intent: Verify round-trip serialization and deserialization for MessagePack arrays around boundary lengths.
